observations: Two photos show what appears to be the same blue plastic drum (or two very similar drums) from slightly different angles.
Drum has a bolted/ratchet metal retaining band holding a removable lid, with visible rust spots on the metal hinges and band.
Two white screw-cap bungs are visible on the lid, both appear closed.
Surface shows scratches, dirt smudges, and a green paint/marker stain on the top and side.
Faint embossed arrow/UN-style markings visible on the side, consistent with industrial/chemical shipping drums.
Background shows other similar drums and jerricans, suggesting a dealer's stock yard rather than a single item for sale.
No interior shot of the drum is provided, so inside condition and residue cannot be seen.
Watermark reads 'SAIVET NIGERIA ENTERPRISE' - a seller/reseller stamp, not an independent certification.
Seller's new reply is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo or video was provided.

Close-up of the rusted metal band/hinges
